definitions.explanation: Woven or knitted material used for making clothing, curtains, and other items. Refers to the material itself, not a finished product.

examples.japanese: {布地|ぬのじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{布地|ぬのじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This fabric feels nice to the touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な{布地|ぬのじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{仕立|した}てた→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{着心地|きごこち}→着心地：07269_kigokochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: A suit tailored from high-quality fabric feels completely different to wear.

notes:
Refers to textile material before it is made into a finished product. Composed of ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ (cloth) + {地|じ} (base material/ground). Commonly used in sewing, fashion, and textile contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布地|ぬのじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{裁|た}つ: to cut fabric
- {布地|ぬのじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose fabric
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布地|ぬのじ}: cotton fabric
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布地|ぬのじ}: silk fabric
- {薄手|うすで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布地|ぬのじ}: thin/lightweight fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧: cloth — a more general and everyday word; can also refer to a finished piece of cloth
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: fabric, material — very similar to {布地|ぬのじ}; also means dough in cooking contexts
- ⟦{織物|おりもの}→織物：10583_orimono⟧: woven fabric, textile — emphasizes the weaving process

USAGE:
{布地|ぬのじ} specifically refers to the raw material, while ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧ is broader. In everyday speech, ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧ is often used interchangeably with {布地|ぬのじ} for fabric.
